token = apis.phone.login(username='9654124977', password='qlOZ]NT')['access_token']
# fetch alarms (all pages)
alarm_list=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.phone.show_alarms(access_token=token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    alarm_list.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1
print('alarms_count', len(alarm_list))
for a in sorted(alarm_list, key=lambda x:x['alarm_id']):
    print(a['alarm_id'], a['label'], a['time'], 'enabled', a['enabled'], 'repeat_days', a['repeat_days'])

# find go to sleep alarm(s)
go=[a for a in alarm_list if a.get('label','').strip().lower() in ['go to sleep','go-to-sleep','go to sleep']]
print('go_to_sleep_matches', len(go), [ (a['alarm_id'], a['time'], a['enabled']) for a in go])

# if multiple, choose the enabled one; else first
chosen=None
if go:
    enabled=[a for a in go if a.get('enabled')]
    chosen = enabled[0] if enabled else go[0]
print('chosen_go_alarm', chosen)

# compute new time +20 minutes
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
fmt='%H:%M'
old=chosen['time']
dt=datetime.strptime(old, fmt)
new=(dt+timedelta(minutes=20)).strftime(fmt)
print('old_time', old, 'new_time', new)
chosen_id=chosen['alarm_id']

# build disable list (all others)
disable_ids=[a['alarm_id'] for a in alarm_list if a['alarm_id']!=chosen_id]
print('disable_ids_count', len(disable_ids), 'ids', sorted(disable_ids))
